title: groundgate review model text, format model-text@1
description: A model text of an app and its statements, each with the spans of the document that it cites (docs/design/review.md section 7). A statement is not a candidate, and the core never admits model text. The offsets are UTF-8 bytes, end exclusive. The statements are in order and do not overlap.

packet.description: The packet whose document the statements cite.

name.description: The name of the model text, in the form of a field name. It is not a field of the schema of the packet.

text.description: The model text, in Unicode NFC, 1 to 65536 bytes as UTF-8.

cites.description: The spans of the document text that the statement cites. An empty list is a statement with no cite.
